description.en: A variant of CMND_SOCCER_BATTLE for starting a standard ("normal") soccer match, outside the scripted-challenge flow. Never called from any shipped script in script_clean/; behavior reconstructed from the native implementation, which mirrors CMND_SOCCER_BATTLE's setup.
ID of the battle script to run.

example.code:
// Start a standard (non-scripted-challenge) soccer match
CMND_SOCCER_BATTLE_NRM("mf01b01", "btl0001");
